title: The numbers look wrong before the leadership review

characters.name: Nadia Petrova
characters.greeting: Leadership is about to quote these numbers. Are they real?

profile.personality: Trusts data, distrusts surprises. Asks 'how do you know?'.
profile.power: Spots a bad metric from the chart's shape
profile.knows: What leadership will decide and when

questions.q: How bad is the drop for leadership?
I'll own this. Anything I should know?

characters.name: Daniel Cho
characters.greeting: The pipeline ran green last night, which is exactly what worries me.

profile.personality: Plumber of the data world. Knows where every number comes from.
profile.power: Traces any metric back to its source
profile.weakness: Speaks fluent SQL, broken small talk

questions.q: Did an upstream table or schema change?
Which table would you check first?

characters.name: Sara Lindqvist
characters.greeting: My quality checks would've screamed — if they'd been turned on.

profile.personality: Guardian of the null rate. Allergic to silent failures.
profile.power: Writes a data test faster than you can blink

questions.q: What check would have caught this?

characters.name: Robert Hale
characters.greeting: I've put these numbers in the board pack. Tell me I don't have to pull them.

profile.personality: Accountable to the board. Needs certainty, fast.
profile.power: Fixes the narrative once given facts

questions.q: Have these numbers been shared yet?
Can I confirm the real numbers in 30 minutes?

characters.name: Felix Wagner
characters.greeting: Is the dashboard broken? My campaign suddenly looks terrible.

profile.weakness: Assumes every dip is their campaign
profile.knows: How the charts looked to users

questions.q: Did your charts look odd today?
